Initial preview release: governed reverse-proxy operations for Traefik, Caddy, and HAProxy.

- Provides a unified toolset (26 tools) for overview, route/service inspection, upstream health, middleware, TLS certificate inventory, traffic/error stats, and runtime config management.
- Includes root cause analyses for backend health, certificate expiry, 5xx error rate, and route conflicts.
- Write operations are governed: enforced audit log, policy/risk-tiers, undo tokens, and token budgets.
- Credentials are stored encrypted; full local governance by default.
- Only mock-validated for now — not run against live proxies. All three platforms supported for read/write where APIs permit.
- Focused strictly on Traefik, Caddy, and HAProxy; excludes managed cloud balancers, firewalls, or non-proxy appliances.
